# Security reporting

Report suspected vulnerabilities privately to [Mark Norgren](mailto:mark@marknorgren.com). Include the affected revision, interface or deployment, reproduction steps, and expected impact. Do not include live credentials or personal data.

Please avoid public issues or pull requests containing vulnerability details until the maintainer has reviewed the report and coordinated disclosure with you.

Security fixes target the current `main` branch. Older revisions have no separate support commitment. This is a maintained personal project with no guaranteed response time or security SLA.
